title: The Bosphorus Brief — Saturday, 15 August 2026
overview: A quieter weekend on the ground in Türkiye, but two threads worth your attention: a UN rebuke of juvenile justice reforms, and a black-market visa appointment bust that's a useful reminder to book only through official channels. Regionally, Hormuz tensions and Black Sea shipping disruptions continue to ripple into energy and currency markets.
sections: <parameter name="heading">Visa appointments: stick to official channels
body: Turkish authorities have ordered the detention of 49 people over the alleged sale of visa appointment slots on the black market, according to Turkish Minute and Türkiye Today. If you or family members are booking appointments for residency or visa processes, use only the official government portals (e-devlet, the Foreigners' Directorate site) — third-party sellers offering "guaranteed" or faster slots are the target of this crackdown, not a legitimate shortcut.
